name: Lisinopril
description: An angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor approved for hypertension, heart failure and post-myocardial-infarction survival. Carries a boxed warning for foetal toxicity.

systems.note: Blood pressure and afterload reduction through ACE inhibition; the labelled indications.
Efferent arteriolar dilation reduces filtration pressure; creatinine rise and hyperkalaemia are labelled.
Cholestatic hepatitis progressing to hepatic necrosis carries a labelled warning.

monitors.why: Hyperkalaemia is a labelled and common effect of ACE inhibition.
Expected early rise from reduced filtration pressure; a large rise is not expected.
The filtration estimate the labelled cautions are expressed against.
